title: Very pleasant
text:
Magnificent and very pleasant hike. 
The starting point was very well indicated and convenient if you are staying in the center of Granada. 
Julio is a great guide who tells lots of anecdotes about the region and takes his time on the hike. 
Also accommodating regarding the return point.

title: Unforgettable Hike in the Sierra Nevada!
text:
We had an incredible experience on our English-speaking hike through the Sierra Nevada! The scenery was absolutely stunning, featuring incredible canyon bridges and fascinating caves that made the route truly unique.

Our guide, Marcello, went above and beyond to make the day special. He kept the group informed and comfortable, provided delicious snacks and cold water, and took fantastic photos of us along the way so we could enjoy the experience. title: Our new favorite in Spain!!
text: FABULOUS morning hike! Beautiful views, vigorous hike. Not for the faint of heart! This hike has some fairly challenging hill climbs and scrambles, plus narrow ledges to pass in crouched positions or on hands & knees, and fairly steep steps and hills. Don't carry a bag or a child on this hike as you will have great difficulty safely getting thru the narrow passages with anything on your back or front.  Our guide was FANTASTIC!

title: Fantastic
text: My husband and I Loved this hike. So scenic and Julio was a great guide, he made it super fun and interesting. You do need a reasonable degree of fitness because of the climb at the beginning and some of the narrow ledges, but it isn’t fast paced at all. I would definitely recommend this if you want to have a change of scenery from the city.
